title: 通胀如期：美联储仍落后，9月加息悬了？
speaker: Tracy Chen

segments.en: Yeah, I think today's inflation number is just as people expected.
segments.zh: 我认为今天的通胀数据符合市场预期。

segments.en: It is like both the headline and core inflation. So to me, it's almost like a non-event, right?
segments.zh: 整体和核心通胀都如此，所以对我来说几乎没什么影响。

segments.en: Initially, the market reacted sharply, cherry rallied and equity rallied, but at the market close, most of the move already faded.
segments.zh: 起初市场反应剧烈，债市和股市都上涨，但收盘时涨幅大多回落。

segments.en: So that shows you the market real concern is not inflation. Most of the cherry sell off recently is driven by real yield, or term premium inflation break even has been very stable.
segments.zh: 这说明市场真正担心的不是通胀。近期债市抛售主要受实际收益率驱动，通胀预期一直很稳定。

segments.en: So I would characterize that the Fed should feel some kind of relief, but that's not a real story behind the cherry sell off. And the Fed is still behind the curve on tackling inflation and to reach their inflation target.
segments.zh: 所以我认为美联储会感到一些宽慰，但这并不是债市抛售的真正原因。美联储在应对通胀方面仍落后于曲线。

segments.en: So I think this will not make them more likely to hike.
segments.zh: 所以我认为这不会增加他们加息的可能性。

segments.en: So I think it's really hard for the Fed to hike in September, because it's so close to midterm, but at the same time, you hope that they should have hiked in July, right? Because inflation is still elevated, yeah.
segments.zh: 所以我认为美联储在9月加息很难，因为临近中期选举，但同时你希望他们7月就该加息，因为通胀仍然偏高。
